messages:
Maya: Heads-up — final price sheet v2 is ready for phase‑gate rollout. Need sign-off on staggered percentages and legacy-preservation rules. TL;DR: A/B split 10/90 (control/new) for first 48h, then 30/70 for next 5 days, then full cutover after 7 days if no regressions. Sheet: https://redir.redwood/pricing/v2 (csv attached).
Jorge: Quick Q — how are we handling existing monthly commitments? We can’t unexpectedly change invoice amounts mid-period.
Maya: Good catch. Plan is preserve current billing rates for active subscriptions until their next renewal window OR a 30‑day grace window, whichever is later. New customers and new subscriptions get new pricing immediately.
Kate: From a comms POV we should add a short billing banner + email for customers who will see a change at renewal. Also confirm promo codes still apply.
Priya: I need a dry invoice run to validate proration logic and rounding. Can we schedule one against staging meter data?
Ben: Ops: we’ll need a feature flag gating rollout and a rollback path. I’ll own the k8s flag and the rollout play. Suggested flag config (staging):
```
pricing_rollout:
  phase1: { pct_new: 10, duration_hours: 48 }
  phase2: { pct_new: 30, duration_hours: 120 }
  full_cutover: { after_days: 7 }
  preserve_legacy: true
  preserve_window_days: 30
```
Jorge: Also need to reconcile invoice line‑item keys — product_id mapping must be stable across old/new price sheets, otherwise downstream ledger will create duplicates. Please include a mapping column in CSV.
Maya: Yes — CSV includes product_id, old_price, new_price, grandfather_key. Minimal snippet:
```
product_id,old_price,new_price,grandfather_key,notes
model-embed-1,0.0006,0.0005,embed-v1-preserve,apply new price to new subs
```
Lia (VendorOps): FYI — vendor pass‑through costs on GPU instances are expected to increase ~3% next quarter. Recommend we absorb for now and re-evaluate margin targets post-rollout.
Jorge: If vendors increase costs, we should gate a price uplift to avoid negative margin on certain SKUs. Can we add a vendor_surge buffer flag?
Maya: We can add a safeguard: if vendor_cost_delta > 5% then halt automated phase2 and notify finance+product. Lia — can you emit a cost delta signal to the rollout dashboard?
Lia (VendorOps): Yep — will push an alert to the rollout dashboard and post to #vendor-alerts.
Accounting Bot: Dry invoice run scheduled: run_id=inv-dry-220123; dataset=staging_meter_2026-03; expected runtime=30m; results will be uploaded to /shared/finance/pricing-rollouts/inv-dry-220123.csv
Priya: I’ll review the dry run output once available. If proration looks good I approve accounting side for phase1 (pending final QA). :white_check_mark:
Ben: Engineering release window set for 09:00 UTC tomorrow for phase1 toggle. I’ll post the deploy bot message at 08:50 with kill-switch instructions.
Kate: Marketing will prepare the billing banner + templated email for renewals impacted in the next 48h. Sending copy to legal for review now.
Maya: Anyone blocking sign-off? Need final approval by EOD today to hit tomorrow morning window.
Priya: Approved from finance (pending dry run pass).
Jorge: Approved assuming mapping column present and vendor buffer check added.
Lia (VendorOps): No blocker from VendorOps.
Ben: Ops ready. Feature flag tested on staging.
Maya: Great — thanks everyone. If no further blockers we’ll flip phase1 tomorrow. :rocket:
